name: GCSE French (AQA 8652)

selected_options.tiers_built: Both Foundation (grades 1-5) and Higher (grades 4-9), consistent with the tiering approach used for GCSE Mathematics and the separate sciences in this course set
selected_options.rebuilt_from: Previous build used the legacy AQA 8658 specification, which AQA now labels 'legacy' and points to 8652 (first teaching September 2024). Rebuilt on 2026-09-19 against 8652 at the user's instruction after a course-auditor drift finding. The 8658 build (stages, rubric, map, exam) is archived outside courses/ in _archive/. This 2026-09-22 rebuild fully itemises the specification (95 items across 21 stages) where the prior 8652 build had only a broad per-topic index with no _syllabus_items.

material_vintage: AQA GCSE French (9-1) 8652 specification, first teaching September 2024 (PDF at filestore.aqa.org.uk/resources/french/specifications/AQA-8652-SP-2024.pdf). Itemised on 2026-09-22 against the live AQA pages: subject-content/themes (confirmed all three theme titles and nine topic titles exactly as previously built), subject-content/grammar (Section 3.2 grammar checklist) and scheme-of-assessment (confirmed paper durations, marks, tiers and the AO1/AO2/AO3 weightings: AO1 35% overall, AO2 45%, AO3 20%). AQA's Appendix 2 vocabulary list and Section 3.2 grammar list are not separately numbered by topic, so all grammar-point and vocabulary-area item ids use an invented, stable AQA-FR-T<theme>.<topic>-<slug>[-F|-H] / AQA-FR-P<paper>-<taskslug> scheme (see items_source and declared in every item). Per-topic grammar allocation (which structure is Foundation vs Higher) is carried over from the prior 8652 build, which the user's own curriculum_map.json stated was already accurate; it was not independently re-verified word-for-word against Section 3.2 in this pass and is flagged for spot-checking. Stage test and exam scenarios are original questions written in the style of AQA papers, never real past-paper items. First live 8652 exams were sat summer 2026; live-series past papers/mark schemes were not available for this rebuild, so task-type detail is drawn from the specification's scheme-of-assessment pages and the specimen assessment material structure referenced in the prior build.
level_source: RQF Level 2 (GCSE, full grade range 1-9 / Foundation+Higher tiers covered); level carried over from the previous 8658/8652 builds of this course and not independently re-confirmed against the Ofqual register entry for 8652 in this pass
framework: AQA level-of-response grids: AO2 communication levels 0-5 and AO3 range/accuracy levels for Writing and Speaking; ticks-to-marks grids for translation; objective marking for Listening and Reading comprehension. AO weightings confirmed on the live AQA scheme-of-assessment page (2026-09-22): AO1 (listening/reading/understanding) 35% overall, AO2 (communicating in speech and writing) 45%, AO3 (accuracy) 20%.
